answer_1.quote: Text-to-SQL has recently gained significant attention in natural language processing and database research . It translates natural language questions into SQL queries, allowing non-experts to easily access data, making it a valuable tool for business intelligence, data exploration, and other data-centric applications.

answer_2.quote: For all benchmarks, we use the execution accuracy (EX) metric  to evaluate the accuracy of the model's predictions. EX measures whether the predicted and gold SQL queries produce identical execution results on the given database.
